name: Lyo.Diagnostic.AspNetCore
tagline: ASP.NET Core integration for `Lyo.Diagnostic`. Per-request scoped breadcrumb trails and exception recording to the in-memory error inbox plus structured logging, without replacing existing problem-details middleware.
description: ASP.NET Core integration for `Lyo.Diagnostic`. Per-request scoped breadcrumb trails and exception recording to the in-memory error inbox plus structured logging, without replacing existing problem-details middleware.

sections.title: Order in the pipeline
items: Placed nearer the route handlers, this middleware is first in line when an exception unwinds.
It records the failure, calls `IStructuredLogEnricher`, then rethrows.
Problem Details / HTTP error bodies can still be built by outer middleware.

sections.title: Options (`DiagnosticWebOptions`)
rows: The inbox only stores occurrences at this severity or higher.
Expected control-flow classifications are skipped when this is `false`.
Tried in order for `RequestMetadata.CorrelationId`; `TraceIdentifier` is the fallback.
